CatalogConfig.title: CatalogConfig
CatalogConfig.description: Singleton live store catalog configuration containing out-of-stock map, custom prices map, custom added products map, and public store WhatsApp number.

configId.description: Identifier for the configuration document (must be 'live').

outOfStockMap.description: Map of product IDs to boolean out-of-stock status (max 200 entries).

customPrices.description: Map of product IDs to custom numeric price in MT (max 200 entries).

customProducts.description: Map of custom products added by the store owner (max 100 entries).

orderWhatsApp.description: Public WhatsApp phone number for receiving store orders.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the configuration was last updated.

OwnerSecuritySetting.title: OwnerSecuritySetting
OwnerSecuritySetting.description: Write-only owner security settings storing the active manager PIN code.

settingId.description: Identifier for the security setting document (must be 'security').

pinCode.description: 4 to 6 digit numeric PIN code for unlocking the manager panel.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the PIN was last updated.

OwnerPinChallenge.title: OwnerPinChallenge
OwnerPinChallenge.description: Write-only atomic batch PIN verification proof document.

challengeId.description: Identifier for the challenge document (must be 'pinChallenge').

submittedPin.description: 4 to 6 digit numeric PIN submitted for verification.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the PIN verification.

/catalogConfig/{configId}.description: Singleton document (configId='live') holding real-time stock, custom prices, and custom products for all clients.

/ownerSettings/{settingId}.description: Write-only singleton document (settingId='security') holding the owner's active PIN code.

/ownerAuth/{challengeId}.description: Write-only singleton document (challengeId='pinChallenge') used to verify the owner PIN atomically.
